vibe_rationale: Huge open-access summer arts festival with a real independent core and hub culture, but mass-market and broad rather than a single curated scene.
fit_notes: A large adult summer audience from January to February, with a hub model that lets a brand host its own venue or bar space. The 256,000 figure is tickets sold in 2025, not total attendance, and Artrage cut ties with fossil-fuel sponsor Woodside in 2024, so values-led partners are welcome.
